_README: The spirit drinks of Switzerland's federal register of AOP and IGP (agricultural products other than wine), kept by the Federal Office for Agriculture (OFAG / BLW). Switzerland is outside the EU GI scheme and the register has no API: the entries are transcribed from the register page (`register_url`, read on the `verified` date — 42 products, four of them under 'Catégorie: Spiritueux', all AOP; no cider, perry or aromatised wine). `name` is the register's string (aliases slash-separated), `decision` the date of the registration decision it cites, `cahier_url` the cahier des charges in the language the application was made in, `resume_url` the 'Résumé de la demande d'enregistrement', whose sections 7 and 8 carry the history and the link to the area (the cahier has neither). scripts/drinks/01_fetch_technical_files.py fetches and sha-pins both; scripts/audit_drinks_coverage.py lists the entries. Pending applications on the same page, not registered: Absinthe du Val-de-Travers (IGP), Grappa Ticino (AOP), Eau-de-vie de Bérudge (AOP).
